text:
Mia: hey @people-ops — quick Q. I'm planning to come back from parental leave 2026-04-20 but want to do 4-hour days for the first 2 weeks. How does that impact payroll, benefits, and my time-off balance? Also what paperwork do I need to fill out? :blush:
Sam (People Ops): congrats Mia! we can support a phased/partial-day return. high level: 1) payroll: we can set you to reduced-hours status and pro-rate pay for the days/hours you work; 2) benefits: typically stay active during approved leave and for phased returns if you keep benefits-eligible status — we'll confirm eligibility with benefits team; 3) paperwork: submit amended leave dates + phased-return agreement. i'll DM the forms.
Mia: thanks. do I need a doctor note for the phased schedule? and will my OOO/calendar block still show so folks don't schedule me?
Riley (People Ops): if original leave was under FMLA, an updated provider note is often requested for changes longer than 2 weeks, but not always — Sam will confirm. re: calendar, put a reduced-hours recurring block and the manager can publish the temporary availability. also recommend adding a quick handoff doc in the team runbook for oncall.
Olivia (Manager): looping me in — i'll handle oncall coverage and adjust sprint tasks. Mia, can you drop a 3-4 bullet handoff list here by EOD? i'll update the team calendar and reroute any demos.
Sam (People Ops): sending two things: `amended_leave_request.pdf` and `phased_return_agreement.pdf` via DocuSign. payroll note: if hours change mid-pay-period we need signed forms before payroll cutoff (the 20th of the month for next-month pay). please return forms 2 business days before cutoff to avoid delays.
Mia: perfect. last thing — can I keep my company laptop during phased return? i'll be doing some childcare pickup during the afternoons and might travel a bit.
Jules (IT): yes you can keep the laptop. if you change shipping address or need a hotspot, DM me.
Finance (Bot): FYI tagging @finance-team for potential childcare travel reimbursement and payroll proration questions.
Sam (People Ops): great — i'll confirm benefits eligibility with Benefits and follow up in this thread once i have the provider note requirement clarified. Mia — i'll DM the DocuSign links now. :smile:
